summary: Frontend-only verification of transparent PNG swap for CYNAIAH and ANCRMEDIA logos in homepage ecosystem. Fresh load via preview URL; both target nodes render with images naturalWidth=1536, naturalHeight=1024, and their logo wrapper computed background is rgba(0,0,0,0) (transparent) — no black rectangle. Clicking node-ancrmedia opens ecosystem-detail with 'ANCRMEDIA' and tagline 'Distribute · Watch · Listen · Stream · Connect'; clicking node-cynaiah shows CYNAIAH Coming Soon state. Regression: node-ancr, node-viearta and other module nodes present; ecosystem-explore-btn present; no console errors; horizontal overflow = 0 at both 1440 and 390 viewports.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 14 verified only the asset swap for cynaiah.png and ancrmedia.png. Both load transparently. No further asset issues in ecosystem section.
